title: Catalog entry: a minted token
summary: DJDL's catalog editor with the minted token applemusic.token open: the recipe and its sealed signing key live on the entry, and a lifetime change pushed from the repo waits for approval, with Review and approve… as the one primary and minting stopped until then.
compare: There is no Edge mint page or nav item: the recipe, the signing key and the approval are all on the catalog entry, and the Catalog nav item carries a warning count while a recipe needs approval.
With no draft and an approval pending, the header has Form or JSON and Close editor only; Review and approve… (passkey glyph) is the callout's action, and no rail card repeats it.

Config's gold accent is never the only cue: a selected Type card is a strong neutral border plus the tick, the open entry is a neutral fill with a neutral edge, and every warning callout has a solid warning rail and a triangle, so selected, changed and needs-approval read differently in both themes.
Type shows Minted token selected; In the app is one fixed line (code only, mintToken("applemusic"), not stored, not listed, doesn't sync); a help button beside Type opens the five-cell table.

Recipe id and Algorithm are fixed text with a lock (What the app asks for; Set by the template); the key is the card's title. Template has its own row; Team ID (iss), Key ID (kid) and Lifetime are editable. Recipe ids never reach customers or discovery.

The approval state is a pill at the card head with exactly one of Needs approval or Changed since approval (Approved is status text, see config.approve-recipe-approved). The callout names what changed, who, where (.pkey/schema, commit) and what it means now, and offers the alternative: set Lifetime back to 1 hour here and commit the same change, or the next resync brings 12 hours back.

The changed field is marked where it is (Lifetime, "Was 1 hour"). Each approval fact shows once: Last approved Sep 14 by Ana Lima is the head's line with Approval history beside it, minting stopped is in the callout, and the key's state is on Signing key; there's no Approval card.
Signing key is one row: what it is (MusicKit private key, .p8), sealed date and who, used only for this token, Replace key…; no key material, fingerprint or secret name.

What DJDL receives is labelled "Preview: a token minted after you approve, decoded" and decodes a mint at a real time (header alg, kid, typ; iss, iat, exp), with the new exp highlighted and "12 hours later" (the field's own hint says "Was 1 hour").
In your app shows mintToken for each SDK DJDL uses (Swift on macOS, Kotlin on Windows) and says not to keep the token.
Phone: the list becomes the entry switcher, the callout's button drops under its text, field pairs stack, and the foot note stays under Remove from catalog.
Spacing and copy pass (2026-10-08): the screen sets no spacing of its own (kit primitives only), and each fact shows once, where it's most useful.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: approving is the one filled action, the Approval card carries it, and selection, change and warning no longer share one look.

findings.issue: The one job, approving, was an outline button while a disabled filled Review changes was the heaviest element, and the Approval card had no action.
findings.resolution: With no draft and an approval pending, Review changes is gone from the header; Review and approve… is the filled primary with the passkey glyph in the callout and is repeated as an outline button at the foot of the Approval card.

findings.issue: The config accent and warning are the same hue, so needs approval, changed and selected looked alike.
findings.resolution: Partly declined: the kit's --pk-warning-* tokens are generated from packages/brand/css by build-kit.mjs, so changing them in the kit would make every area's mockups differ from the built console; that is a brand-token change for the brand owner, and the lead can route it. Done on the config screens instead: warning callouts carry a solid 4px warning rail, the selected Type card is a strong neutral border with the tick (no gold fill), and the open entry is a neutral fill with a neutral edge. Rechecked on entry-setting and approve-recipe.

findings.issue: The change was stated five times and the Approval card's values wrapped awkwardly.
findings.resolution: Pill, callout and the Lifetime hint stay. The Approval card is state and history only (Last approved Sep 14 by Ana Lima; Minting stopped since Oct 6, 21:14; Signing key sealed Oct 2), with labels above values so nothing wraps mid-value, plus the action and Approval history. The Recipe and What changed rows are gone.

findings.issue: "Decoded, for a token minted now" showed a 12-hour exp while minting is stopped.
findings.resolution: Labelled "Preview: a token minted after you approve, decoded."; the claims comment reads "if minted Oct 7, 2026 17:00 UTC" and the exp line says "12 hours (was 1)".

findings.issue: Template was truncated, the Recipe hint floated right, the receives heading wrapped on phone, and the foot note was dropped on phone.
findings.resolution: Template has a full row with Recipe id and Algorithm below it; each section's hint sits under its heading at every width; the foot note shows on phone under Remove from catalog.

findings.issue: No state for a recipe without a signing key, no wizard, and no word on setting Lifetime back instead of approving.
findings.resolution: Added config.entry-minted-token-no-key and config.mint-wizard; the callout now says: "Or set Lifetime back to 1 hour below and commit the same change to .pkey/schema; otherwise the next resync brings 12 hours back."

findings.issue: The lifetime change was stated four times and the undo was a manual two-step; minted pages left about 430px dead at wide.
findings.resolution: Said once in the banner ("Lifetime changed from 1 hour to 12 hours in .pkey/schema (Jonah Ortiz, Oct 6). Minting is stopped until you approve.") with a Keep 1 hour button; "Was 1 hour" removed; recipe subtitle "Signed with your key; it never leaves Polaris Key"; three-column editor at wide (list, form capped 880px, 320px sticky rail of approval history, who can get one, where it is used); list folds to the top selector at tablet; phone keeps Form|JSON beside Review with Discard behind the overflow.

findings.issue: Hide "Where it's set" behind the overflow menu on narrower sizes (UX1)
findings.resolution: declined: Conflicts with the rail-on-every-editor decision. The card stays visible and sits in the rail at wide, below the form otherwise.
